items.title: Contingency
items.description:
5% Contingency to be used toward covering costs related to found conditions. Calculated at 5% of subtotal contract price.
*Unused contingency is credited on the final invoice.

items.title: Change Order(s) Management
items.description:
5% allowance for project management of change orders that may arise during the project: scoping, pricing, documentation and rescheduling. Time spent is recorded on each change order and drawn from this allowance at the project management rate.
*Unused allowance is credited on the final invoice.

items.title: Allowance Fees
items.description: Allowance for freight, delivery, and tax paid at purchase on all allowance materials and hardware. Capital improvement per Form E-589CI; no sales tax is charged on Contractor invoices.
